page.layout: One page of text, verse in two stanzas-blocks with numbered poems (14 and 15) and French/Latin mixed lines; running head at top centre with page number at top right; signature mark at lower right of text block. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Quem fluctus unda, quem rotat impetus-
14. Quand le iour fils du Soleil,
15. Orfeure, taille moy vne boule bien

l.i: Copia frugum, & opes benignæ.Insculpe tales dehinc titulos globo.

page.notes: Lines of the first stanza and the "Quum Sol" stanza are set in italic; the French lines of headings 14 and 15 are in roman. "Intus canatum" and "vary" and "Pictáque" appear as printed; "canatum" likely printing error for "caelatum" and "vary" for "vario" — left as printed. Section mark of the final signature "K. ij." read with some uncertainty ("ij" possibly "ij." ). Two-line marginal ornaments and catchwords are absent.
